purpose: Single source of truth for canary deployment of the cynic binary to fleet machines. Data, not code: the plan, the order, the gates, and the rollback ladder are declared here; cynic-release decides from this file, cynic-cli renders the plan, and (couche B) the executor applies it. Couche A executes manually following the safe-production-deploy procedure.

health.name: version_match
health.description: Deployed binary reports the deployed commit SHA
health.pass_condition: output contains the deployed source SHA

health.name: smoke
health.description: Deployed binary answers a read-only probe through the real path

health.name: pid_cycled
health.description: The service process actually restarted (PID changed)
health.pass_condition: post-deploy PID differs from pre-deploy PID

backup.retain: last-known-good plus current live only; older backups are removed by every deploy

containment_ladder.name: config_out
containment_ladder.action: remove the new stanza, restart, probe

containment_ladder.name: stop_and_diagnose
containment_ladder.action: stop deploying, diagnose the host (disk, locks, flood)
containment_ladder.clears: environmental causes when both rungs fail

promotion_rule: A step promotes to the next machine only when all its health gates pass. Any gate failure climbs the containment ladder before any further promotion. Couche A: ladder climbed manually. Couche C: ladder climbed automatically.
